dietsetup:handbook-body:
Vintage Story tracks nutrition across five food categories: Fruit, Vegetable, Protein, Grain and Dairy. Keeping all five topped up raises your maximum health, and eating anything keeps your overall satiety from running out (which causes starvation damage over time).

Your character has a diet, and every food item is scored against it. Most food is simply Edible, but some is Especially Nourishing for your diet (extra satiety and nutrition), Harmful (it makes you sick), or Inedible (no benefit at all). The tooltip on a food item tells you which, if it isn't plain Edible.

Your diet is normally set by your race; use /diettags to see how the item in your hand is tagged, or /dietresolve <dietId> to check how it would score against a specific diet.
